[20/10/2026, 09:01] Achieng: Hi, is the Samsung A15 still available?
[20/10/2026, 09:03] Brian: Yes it is. 128GB, blue, very clean
[20/10/2026, 09:04] Achieng: How much?
[20/10/2026, 09:05] Brian: 13,500
[20/10/2026, 09:07] Achieng: That's a lot. Can you do 11k?
[20/10/2026, 09:10] Brian: 11 is too low. Last price 12,000
[20/10/2026, 09:12] Achieng: Sawa, 12k is fine. Does the screen have any cracks?
[20/10/2026, 09:13] Brian: No cracks at all, and it comes with the original charger
[20/10/2026, 09:15] Achieng: Ok. I'm in Nakuru, can you send via G4S?
[20/10/2026, 09:16] Brian: Yes. I'll drop it at G4S by Thursday
[20/10/2026, 09:17] Achieng: Perfect, deal
notes: Relative date: negotiation 13,500 -> 12,000 and 'by Thursday' said on Tue 20 Oct resolves to ship_by 2026-10-22.
